items.name: Monofilament katana
items.text: A curved blade with an edge one molecule wide. It hums faintly when drawn.

items.name: Combat knife
items.text: Black-coated carbon steel with a hilt tape that never gets slippery.

items.name: Suppressed pistol
items.text: A light pistol with a baffle in the muzzle. It coughs where others shout.

items.name: Heavy pistol
items.text: A solid slab of a sidearm with a smart-link sight and a kick like an argument.

items.name: Shock baton
items.text: A telescoping baton with a capacitor that snaps blue when it hits.

items.name: Smart SMG
items.text: A compact submachine gun that curves its rounds around corners if you ask nicely.

items.name: Arc blade
items.text: A short blade wrapped in a lattice of arcing current. It smells of ozone.

items.name: Scrap cleaver
items.text: A butcher's cleaver welded to a length of rebar. Ugly, effective.

items.name: Kevlar vest
items.text: Layered ballistic cloth, patched with duct tape and pride.

items.name: Armoured jacket
items.text: A stylish jacket with a lining of plates you can't see and can feel.

items.name: Weave coat
items.text: A long coat of woven ceramic fibre that sheds rain and rounds with equal ease.

items.name: Riot plate
items.text: A transparent polycarbonate shield with a Spire security stencil half scraped away.

items.name: Stim shot
items.text: A spring-loaded injector of something that tastes like batteries and works anyway.

items.name: Trauma medkit
items.text: Clotting foam, staples and a sealed pack of nanite gel.

items.name: Synth noodles
items.text: A foil bowl of hot noodles in a broth of pure salt and optimism.

items.name: Real coffee

use.message: Actual coffee, from an actual bean. Your hands stop shaking.

items.text: A tiny vacuum-sealed pouch of real coffee grounds. In Lowtide it is worth more than a coat.

items.name: Coolant vial
items.text: A vial of chilled gel that cools overheated implants and bruised skin alike.

items.name: Cyberdeck
items.text: A flat black slab with a screen and a hundred hand-soldered ports. The one tool you never leave behind.

items.name: Lockbreaker kit
items.text: A roll of picks, shims and a tiny capacitor-driven rattle gun.

items.name: Scrap circuit
items.text: A green board studded with salvageable parts. Wick will buy it.

items.name: Corp badge
items.text: A glossy white ID card with an Aurelian audit logo. Real enough to open doors.

items.name: Lucky chip
items.text: A scratched credit chit you've carried since you were nine. It has never been worth anything but luck.

items.name: Extraction receipt
items.text: A flat black chip with your handwriting on the sticker: Platform Nine.

items.name: Lease override chip
items.text: A coded Aurelian chip that can unlock a leased machine for good.

items.name: Saint's lantern
items.text: A small paper lantern with a saint's face inked on it. The Lantern Saints' gates open for it.

items.name: Memory shard
items.text: A thumb-sized shard of glass that hums with someone's six missing weeks. Yours.

items.name: Analog cassette
items.text: A real magnetic tape, hand-labelled in marker. Who has the player for it, though?

items.name: Jasmine tea
items.text: A paper tin of actual jasmine leaves. It smells like a world with no rain.

items.name: Paper lantern
items.text: A hand-folded lantern with a tiny LED inside. Lowtide's way of saying I am thinking of you.

items.name: Synth flower
items.text: A single flower grown in a vat, petals that shift gently between pink and blue.

items.name: Vinyl record
items.text: An old record in a water-stained sleeve. Whoever once owned it clearly loved it.

items.name: Cheap whisky
items.text: A flask of something amber that burns going down and keeps burning.
